parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, made primarily of glass. It is a flat, rectangular component that forms the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output such as images, videos, and text. It is the primary interface for viewing content.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed to the stand and does not move independently, though the entire display may tilt or swivel depending on the mount.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic. It supports the screen and provides stability on a flat surface.
parts.Functional_description: The base holds the display upright and may contain mechanisms for tilt or rotation. It ensures the display remains stable during use.
parts.Movement_description: The base itself is stationary, but it may allow limited rotation or tilt of the screen through an internal hinge or pivot mechanism.
